description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Table Storage implementation of transactional state storage in the Orleans framework. It defines test classes, helper methods for initializing storage tables, and uses external libraries such as Azure.Data.Tables, Xunit, and Orleans.Transactions.

classes.name: TestState
classes.description: A simple class representing the state used in transactional storage tests, implementing IEquatable for comparison.

classes.name: AzureTransactionalStateStorageTests
classes.description: A test class for Azure Table Storage transactional state storage, inheriting from a test runner and using xUnit fixtures.

methods.name: StateStorageFactory
methods.description: Creates and initializes an AzureTableTransactionalStateStorage instance for testing.

methods.name: InitTableAsync
methods.description: Initializes the Azure storage table, creating it if it does not exist, and returns a TableClient.

methods.name: GetCloudTableCreationClient
methods.description: Retrieves the TableServiceClient used to create or access storage tables.
